body: 🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: "leaves a tile empty" only checks that no image is drawn, not that an empty tile is there** The test asserts `tiles(late.container)` has length 0, so it only proves that no `` was rendered. It would still pass if the strip dropped the null tiles entirely (other tiles would then shift into the gap), or if it rendered no strip at all. The component renders a placeholder `` for each null tile (webcam-lane.tsx:127). To pin the behaviour the test names, also assert that the strip exists and holds the expected number of placeholder tiles, for example `[data-webcam-filmstrip] span`.
